entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • resx source generator emits invalid C# for namespace when .resx file is an absolute path #81991
  • IDE0052 not taking extension into account #81986
  • A duplicate error is reported for an ambiguous user-defined conversion #81984
    Backlog

Closed

  • Missing nullability warning on tuple conversion for receiver of extension member #81851
    18.3
  • Missing inputs in the key file #65474
    18.3
  • Parenthesized enum constant pattern with when guard misparsed as nested type (CS0426 & CS0103) #81837
    18.3
  • IDE0270 is firing in a case that can't be simplified #81987
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11412.192 #81989
  • Folder for compiler generated files set by CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath not created #81970
